name: threadpacket
description: Threadpacket sends a packet from one person's AI assistant to another person's assistant: a brief of the work so far, with the original files.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:hosted: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.hosted.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.hosted.jsonc

DB.description: D1 database for packets, attachment records, members, sign-ins and console activity. Created for you.

FILES.description: Workers KV namespace for the original files sent with a packet (PDF, PNG, JPEG, Markdown, plain text). Created for you; on the free plan.

THREADPACKET_SETUP_CODE.description: A code you choose, 12 characters or more (for example from `openssl rand -base64 18`). After deploying, open `/console/setup` on your Worker and enter it to become the admin. It works only while no admin exists.
